summary: SAMEIET LANGESGATE 9 (org. no. 882 715 752) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-01-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Karen Skarbøvik Mellbye.
